name: hunt_route
purpose: Pick the next allowlisted witness question during a hunt. Can only choose from the allowlisted questions, or hand the hunt to the LLM when unsure.
state_template: HUNT LOG SO FAR: <investigation goal, questions already asked, condensed answers, open hypothesis>.

next_question.instructions: Given the evidence gathered so far, which witness question should the observatory ask next?

criteria.attest: Confirm the witness is alive and can actually see (blind check first)
criteria.sketch: Admin failures, new local admins, privileged services, new services or tasks
criteria.edges: Tracked logons, explicit-credential uses, outbound connections
criteria.explain: Identity/service/task changes, LOLBin spawns, audit-log clearing
criteria.netedges: Sysmon conns, DNS, LSASS access, thread injection, file/registry writes
criteria.pslogs: The actual PowerShell code being executed (4104 script blocks)
criteria.escalate_to_llm: Evidence is ambiguous, novel, or the path is unclear — let the LLM reason about the hunt
criteria.deepwindow: Short-lived ETW kernel trace at full fidelity
